北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京天晴但体感 3℃，记得添衣保暖，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels like 3℃. Remember to dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雾，出行注意安全，空气湿润小心湿滑。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy, travel safely. Humid air might make surfaces slippery.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天体感 6℃，微凉，记得多穿件外套哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels like 6℃, a bit chilly. Remember to wear an extra jacket.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天体感 26℃，有点热哦，注意防暑补水。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and feels like 26℃, a bit hot. Stay hydrated and cool.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天体感 24℃，注意补水，防潮也很重要。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and feels like 24℃. Stay hydrated, and mind the humidity.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天有风体感 4℃，出门别忘添衣，注意防风。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and windy, feels like 4℃. Dress warm and mind the wind.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京湿度高体感 4℃，穿暖点，别让湿冷钻空子。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is humid and feels like 4℃. Dress warm to fend off the damp chill.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云体感 18℃，早晚温差大，别忘了添减衣物。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 18℃. Mind the day-night temperature difference; dress accordingly.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天体感 6℃，微凉，注意保暖，多喝热水哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and feels like 6℃, a bit chilly. Keep warm and drink more hot water.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天体感 3℃，湿冷感强，多穿衣别冻着了。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and feels like 3℃, quite chilly. Dress warm to avoid freezing.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云体感 18℃，挺舒适的，注意防晒补水。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and feels like 18℃, quite pleasant. Remember sun protection and hydration.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨-9℃，体感-10℃！出门务必全副武装，注意防寒。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is -9℃, feels like -10℃! Bundle up completely when going out, protect against cold.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗体感-2℃，小心地滑，注意添衣保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels like -2℃. Watch for icy patches, dress warmly.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗体感 18℃，风力不小，小心着凉，注意防晒。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and feels like 18℃. It's windy, be careful not to catch a cold, and use sun protection.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，能见度低，出行一定注意交通安全。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy with low visibility. Please ensure traffic safety when traveling.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云体感 0℃，湿冷感强，多穿点，别冻感冒了。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels like 0℃, quite chilly. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云体感 0℃，湿气重，多穿衣物，小心湿滑。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels like 0℃, high humidity. Dress warmly and watch for slippery surfaces.
